title: Provincia del Limarí
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: Can a rural and agricultural territory, with chronic water stress, economic contraction, and youth emigration, be transformed into an eco-cultural tourist destination of national and international interest? This book offers concrete proposals based on the identification, visibility, and appreciation of its identity and heritage. It proposes the creation of the Lapis Lazuli Route, the strengthening of the Ancestral Pisqueras Route, and the integration of heritage restaurants and hotels. The aim is to raise awareness of the unique value of natural and cultural heritage, with all its potential to create a unique and highly interesting tourist destination. Based on the innovative concept of the economy of culture, the text proposes ideas such as the creation of virtual classrooms and interpretation centers that contribute to understanding the universal meaning and value of local wealth.
